title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when their batteries drained while stuck in heavy traffic. At least a dozen vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, were left stationary after major traffic disruptions, high volumes of travelers, and unplanned road closures created unexpected congestion near the Golden Gate Bridge. The system was deployed in conditions it had not been designed or tested for: extreme traffic events that created standstill conditions lasting hours.

This reveals a failure in operational planning rather than a model failure. The autonomous vehicles operated as designed, but the deployment lacked sufficient buffer capacity or contingency protocols for rare but foreseeable traffic scenarios. Human intervention was needed to clear the stranded vehicles, and the incident shows what would have prevented it: either sufficient battery reserve for extended gridlock, rerouting logic to avoid bottlenecks during known major events, or human dispatch decisions that keep vehicles away from high-congestion areas during peak travel times.

One vehicle also caught fire after driving over fireworks on the street, though no injuries were reported and it is not established whether this represents a separate failure in hazard detection or an unavoidable hazard in the deployment environment.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
# Summary

Multiple Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations on Saturday after their batteries drained in heavy traffic. Videos verified by NBC News showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo vehicles, many of them Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on streets following a fireworks display near the Golden Gate Bridge. The company attributed the situation to major traffic disruptions, high volumes of travelers, and unplanned road closures that created unexpected congestion. Waymo's roadside assistance team worked to clear the vehicles, and the company stated it is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic events.

The incident also included a Waymo vehicle that caught fire after driving over fireworks that were set off on the street, though no injuries were reported. Some riders spent nearly two hours in standstill traffic, and bystanders grew frustrated seeing autonomous vehicles with no drivers stuck in the congestion. San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie's office indicated it will meet with public and private partners to ensure smoother traffic management for future large events in the city.
